content:
BUITL CoLAB was present at the 1st Annual Meeting of Collaborative Laboratories, organized by the National Innovation Agency, which took place on October 16 and 17 in Porto.

Rita Moura, Chairman of the Board of Directors, and Paulo Fonseca, Executive Director of BUILT CoLAB, were our representatives at this extremely profitable event, where we had the opportunity to get to know even better the other 25 CoLAB’s who, like us, are dedicated to innovation. It was a space for sharing, networking and collaboration.

We thank again the National Innovation Agency, which has successfully organized this event!
